test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Constitutional Amendment led to inclusion of Sikkim in the Indian Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**36th**____** Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Constitution(36th Amendment) Act **of 1975 made** Sikkim the 22nd state of India.**
 
• The Act stipulates that the **Legislative Assembly of Sikkim** must have at least 32 members and that the Assembly of Sikkim formed as a result of the elections held in Sikkim in April 1974, with 32 members elected (hereinafter referred to as the sitting members), shall be deemed to be the legislative Assembly of the State of Sikkim duly constituted under the Constitution."
 
• **Sikkim** is located in the northeastern part of the country, with a land area of 7096 km and a population of 5 lakhs and 40 thousand people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• On April 26, 1975, Parliament approved the **Constitution (37th Amendment) Act, 1975,** which established a Legislative Assembly and a Council of Ministers in Arunachal Pradesh, the country's north-easternmost Union Territory.
 
• **34th Amendment Act, 1974** included twenty more land tenure and land reforms acts of various states in the Ninth Schedule.
